arguments.summary: Investigated the root cause of the p99 latency spike and found it to be related to pgbouncer. The connection pool was not properly handling the refresh, leading to increased latency. The postmortem export of the failed_jobs table has been initiated using pg_dump. The next steps will involve reviewing the pgbouncer logs and service status, and possibly tuning the connection pool configuration.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review pgbouncer logs and service status for any issues, and tune the connection pool configuration as needed. Once the connection pool is properly configured, start processing the failed jobs backlog.
